column4: https://www.spanishdict.com/translate/fajar : "to put a wraparound band on" / cover with a band (standard transitive sense)
https://www.spanishdict.com/translate/faldear : "to skirt" go around the foot of a hill
https://www.spanishdict.com/translate/filiar : "to take down details" record identifying info for enrollment
https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/florear : "adornar o guarnecer con flores" adorn/embellish
https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/fraguar : "secarse y endurecerse" set/harden (cement) is the everyday sense
